up: Retrieve the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (from activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Join activities with assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_structures on molregno. Apply filters: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2414', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606, activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT assays.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2414' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 AND activities.standard_type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, assays.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
